# Numerical source files copied byte-for-byte from the validated deployment.
find_package(OpenMP REQUIRED)
add_library(insplad_postprocess STATIC src/postprocess.cpp)
target_include_directories(insplad_postprocess PUBLIC include)
target_compile_options(insplad_postprocess PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off)
add_library(insplad_detection STATIC src/detection.cpp)
target_link_libraries(insplad_detection PUBLIC insplad_postprocess)
target_compile_options(insplad_detection PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off)
add_library(insplad_scoring STATIC src/scoring.cpp)
target_include_directories(insplad_scoring PUBLIC include)
target_link_libraries(insplad_scoring PUBLIC OpenMP::OpenMP_CXX)
target_compile_options(insplad_scoring PRIVATE -O3 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off)
option(EDGEINSPECT_BUILD_REFERENCE_TOOLS "Build original C++ numerical reference tools" ON)
if(EDGEINSPECT_BUILD_REFERENCE_TOOLS)
  add_executable(insplad_roi_fixture tools/roi_fixture.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(insplad_roi_fixture PRIVATE insplad_postprocess)
  target_compile_options(insplad_roi_fixture PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off)
  add_executable(insplad_rknn_eval tools/rknn_eval.cpp)
  target_include_directories(insplad_rknn_eval PRIVATE ${RKNN_INCLUDE_DIR})
  target_link_libraries(insplad_rknn_eval PRIVATE insplad_detection insplad_scoring ${RKNN_LIBRARY} ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
  target_compile_options(insplad_rknn_eval PRIVATE -O3 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off)
endif()
